items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, I think I met him with and through John Hammond.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think I met him with and through John Hammond.

When you began to arrange for the Let’s Dance broadcasts, and this is something that seems to have almost been overlooked entirely. Everyone thinks Benny Goodman, Fletcher Henderson, that’s it. But you actually arranged for the Goodman orchestra before Fletcher Henderson did, and were the first arranger for this orchestra that he took into Billy Rose and . . .
I don’t know that I was the first arranger. I’m sure someone else was doing work for him, too.
